newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Banco Espirito BESN, IN launches 15 bln esc bonds.
newsitem.headline: Banco Espirito BESN, IN launches 15 bln esc bonds.

text.p: Banco Espirito Santo is launching 15 billion escudos of 10-year subordinated bonds, indexed to six-month Lisbor plus 15 basis points, joint lead banks said.

The issue is made at par and carries a call option exercisable at the expiry of the 11th, 13th and 16th coupons with the addition of a premium of 0.125, 0.100 and 0.075 percent, respectively, they said.
The joint lead banks are Banco Essi, Banco Portugues de Investimento and Caixa Geral de Depositos.
